name: Gary
tendency text: Strongly tends to repeat whatever it threw last round.
flavor (unused in UI): Found something that works. Will not be taking questions.

name: Hank
tendency text: Throws Rock most of the time. After losing three times in a row, briefly loses faith and avoids Rock.
behaviour rules: abandons its favourite after a losing streak (tiltAfterLosses={"losses":3,"weight":1.5})
flavor (unused in UI): Has a favourite. You can probably guess which.

name: Pam
tendency text: Throws Paper most of the time. After losing three times in a row, briefly avoids Paper.
behaviour rules: abandons its favourite after a losing streak (tiltAfterLosses={"losses":3,"weight":1.5})
flavor (unused in UI): Middle management energy. Loves a good document.

name: Cassie
tendency text: Throws Scissors most of the time. After losing three times in a row, briefly avoids Scissors.
behaviour rules: abandons its favourite after a losing streak (tiltAfterLosses={"losses":3,"weight":1.5})
flavor (unused in UI): Runs with scissors. Professionally.

name: Otto
tendency text: Tends to throw the move that beats its own last throw: Rock → Paper → Scissors → Rock.
behaviour rules: throws what beats its own last throw (cycle=4)
flavor (unused in UI): Believes in taking turns. All three of them.

name: Polly
tendency text: Tends to copy YOUR previous throw.
flavor (unused in UI): Sincerest form of flattery. Also the only form.

name: Lenny
title (shown): Has Had the Same Song Stuck in His Head Since 2009
tendency text: Usually repeats a short sequence (3 or 4 throws), like R, R, P, S… but sometimes slips. New sequence each time you meet; it restarts after every store.
behaviour rules: repeats a short sequence (new one each encounter) (loop={"weight":5,"minLen":3,"maxLen":4})
flavor (unused in UI): Da da DUM, da da DUM. He can’t stop. He won’t stop.

name: Sal
tendency text: Never repeats a throw that just lost: it’s cursed. Tends to keep a throw that just won. After a tie, tends to move on to the next throw (Rock → Paper → Scissors).
behaviour rules: throws what beats its own last throw (cycle=2); after winning, repeats (winStay=2.5); never repeats a throw that just lost (multiplier) (avoidLoser=0)
flavor (unused in UI): Wearing the lucky socks. Has not washed the lucky socks.

name: Connor
tendency text: Tends to throw whatever would have beaten YOUR previous throw.
flavor (unused in UI): Well, actually…

name: Pete
tendency text: After winning, tends to repeat its throw. After losing, tends to switch to whatever would have beaten you. After a tie, leans toward repeating.
behaviour rules: repeats its own last throw (repeatOwn=1.2); after winning, repeats (winStay=4); after losing, switches to what would have won (loseShift=4)
flavor (unused in UI): If it ain’t broke, throw it again.

name: Olga
tendency text: After winning, tends to switch to the next move in the cycle (Rock → Paper → Scissors). After losing, tends to stubbornly repeat. After a tie, leans toward the next move.
behaviour rules: throws what beats its own last throw (cycle=1.2); after winning, moves on in the cycle (winShift=4); after losing, repeats (loseStay=4)
flavor (unused in UI): Wins make her nervous. Losses make her stubborn.

name: Carl
tendency text: Tends to throw whichever move it has thrown the LEAST against you so far.
flavor (unused in UI): Needs an even number of each. It’s a whole thing.

name: Lou
tendency text: Picks a lucky move and leans on it for a streak of 4–9 rounds, then picks a new one.
behaviour rules: picks a lucky move for a streak (favoritePhase={"weight":4,"minLen":4,"maxLen":9})
flavor (unused in UI): Has a system. The system is vibes.

name: Sigrid
tendency text: Watches your last 6 throws and tends to counter your most common one. The more lopsided your habits, the harder it commits.
behaviour rules: beats your most common recent throw (counterPlayerFreq={"weight":4,"window":6})
flavor (unused in UI): Tell me about your Rock.

name: Miranda
tendency text: Tends to throw what YOU threw two rounds ago.
behaviour rules: copies your throw from 2 rounds ago (mirrorTwoBack=4)
flavor (unused in UI): Is on a slight delay.

name: Kai
tendency text: Looks random, but leans toward the move that beats its own throw from two rounds ago.
behaviour rules: beats its own throw from 2 rounds ago (echoTwoBack=3)
flavor (unused in UI): Beep boop. Entropy.

name: Moira
tendency text: Switches mood every 5 rounds (shown above your throws). Stubborn: tends to repeat her own last throw. Spiteful: tends to throw whatever would have beaten YOUR last throw.
behaviour rules: swaps between two behaviour sets every N rounds (moods={"period":5,"a":{"repeatOwn":3},"b":{"counterPlayerLast":3},"names":["Stubborn","Spiteful"]})
flavor (unused in UI): Two moods. Neither of them is “fine”.

name: Delphine
tendency text: Learns what you usually throw after your previous throw and tends to counter it; also punishes favourite moves. Being unpredictable is the defence.
behaviour rules: beats your most common recent throw (counterPlayerFreq={"weight":1.5,"window":10}); beats what you usually throw after your last throw (counterPlayerBigram=4)
flavor (unused in UI): Has read your chat history. Metaphorically.

name: Felix
title (shown): Tells You Exactly What He’ll Do
tendency text: Announces a throw, then usually throws whatever beats the throw that would beat his announcement. He also remembers how you answered his last announcement and expects the same answer again.
behaviour rules: announces a throw, then bluffs / tells the truth / beats how you answered last time (bluff={"bluff":2,"honest":0.8,"read":2.5})
flavor (unused in UI): Wears sunglasses indoors. Announces his throw. Lies about it.

name: John
tendency text: Perfectly random. No pattern exists. Your only tools here are saves, lives, and an opponent reroll.
flavor (unused in UI): Emotionally unavailable. Mathematically unbeatable.
